name: Exp_HullTrendOSMA
summary: This EA trades based on the HullTrendOSMA custom indicator, which applies Hull moving average smoothing to an OSMA-style oscillator. It opens buy positions when the oscillator turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable money management and separate open/close controls.
summary_zh: 该EA基于HullTrendOSMA自定义指标进行交易，该指标对OSMA震荡器应用Hull移动平均平滑处理。当震荡器向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓，并提供可配置的资金管理和独立的开平仓控制。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于HullTrendOSMA震荡指标的趋势转折信号，通过双重平滑算法（XMA_Method和XMA_Method1）减少噪音产生交易信号。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]（震荡器下降趋势）且Value[0]>=Value[1]（开始回升）时开多仓；当Value[1]>Value[2]（震荡器上升趋势）且Value[0]<=Value[1]（开始回落）时开空仓。出场条件依赖反向信号触发平仓，同时设有固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金百分比等方式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数选择仓位计算模式，但缺乏根据市场波动性动态调整的机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend reversal signals from the HullTrendOSMA oscillator indicator, which uses double smoothing algorithms (XMA_Method and XMA_Method1) to reduce noise and generate trading signals. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when Value[1]<Value[2] (oscillator declining) and Value[0]>=Value[1] (starting to rise); a sell position opens when Value[1]>Value[2] (oscillator rising) and Value[0]<=Value[1] (starting to fall). Exit conditions rely on reverse signals triggering position closure, supplemented by fixed pip-based stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing supports multiple modes including fixed lot, balance percentage, and free margin percentage. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter for risk ratio and MMMode for lot calculation mode, but lacks dynamic adjustment based on market volatility.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management: lot size or margin ratio control

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（固定手数/余额百分比/可用保证金百分比等）
parameters.description_en: Money management mode: lot or margin ratio

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号确认K线索引（0=当前K线，1=前一根已完成K线）

pros: 使用Hull移动平均双重平滑减少虚假信号，提高信号质量
开仓和平仓信号独立可控，灵活性高，可单独禁用买入或卖出方向
支持多种资金管理模式，适应不同风险偏好的交易者
使用SignalBar参数确认信号K线，避免未完成K线的虚假信号
有新K线检测机制（IsNewBar），避免同一K线内重复交易
pros_en: Double Hull moving average smoothing reduces false signals and improves signal quality
Independent open/close signal controls provide high flexibility, allowing separate disable of buy or sell direction
Multiple money management modes accommodate traders with different risk preferences
SignalBar parameter confirms signal on completed candles, avoiding false signals from uncompleted bars
New bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) prevents duplicate trades within the same bar
cons: 止损和止盈为固定点数，未考虑市场波动性（如ATR），在不同行情下可能不合适
缺乏持仓数量检查，可能在不同信号周期下重复开仓导致仓位过重
依赖自定义指标HullTrendOSMA，若指标文件缺失则EA无法运行
未设置最大持仓限制和最大回撤保护机制
震荡行情中趋势跟踪策略容易频繁止损
cons_en: Fixed pip stop loss and take profit do not account for market volatility (e.g., ATR), which may be inappropriate in different market conditions
Lacks position count checking, potentially leading to over-positioning from repeated entries across signal periods
Depends on the custom HullTrendOSMA indicator file; EA fails if the indicator is missing
No maximum position limit or maximum drawdown protection mechanism
Trend-following strategy prone to frequent stop-outs in choppy/ranging markets
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自动调整止损止盈距离
增加持仓数量限制和最大回撤保护，防止过度交易和资金损失过大
增加震荡行情过滤器（如ADX或波动率阈值），在无明显趋势时暂停交易
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to automatically adjust distances based on market volatility
Add position count limits and maximum drawdown protection to prevent over-trading and excessive capital loss
Add a range/choppy market filter (e.g., ADX or volatility threshold) to pause trading when no clear trend exists

risk_points: 固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动性，在高波动行情中可能止损过小导致频繁止损
缺乏持仓数量检查，可能在连续信号下重复开仓导致仓位过重
趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中会产生连续亏损信号
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss/take profit does not consider market volatility; in high-volatility conditions stops may be too tight causing frequent stop-outs
Lacks position count checks; consecutive signals may lead to repeated entries and over-positioning
Trend-following strategy generates consecutive losing signals in ranging/choppy markets
